// Generated from packages/capability-release-reporting/workflows/release_report_flow/release_report_flow.workflow-source.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
digraph release_report_flow {
    label = "release_report_flow"
    workflow_source = "packages/capability-release-reporting/workflows/release_report_flow/release_report_flow.workflow-source.mjs"
    typed_action_transport_mode = "enforced"
    workdir = "."
    build_release_report_context [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="release.build_report_context" label="Build release report context" output_key="release_report_context" action_repo="${gh_repo}" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_output_contract="release.report_context@v1" action_repo_path="${repo_path}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    build_release_slack_blocks [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="release.build_slack_blocks" label="Build release Slack Block Kit payload" output_key="release_slack_payload" action_context_b64="${release_report_context_b64}" action_input_contract="release.report_context@v1+release.narrative@v1" action_narrative_b64="${release_narrative_b64}" action_output_contract="release.slack_payload@v1" action_report_issue_url="${release_report_issue_url}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    create_shaping_followup_issue [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="release.shaping_followup" label="Create example-web comprehension follow-up issue (best-effort)" output_key="release_shaping_followup_delivery" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_context_b64="${release_report_context_b64}" action_input_contract="release.report_context@v1+release.narrative@v1" action_narrative_b64="${release_narrative_b64}" action_output_contract="release.shaping_followup_delivery@v1" action_repo_path="${repo_path}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    done [shape="Msquare" recovery_sink_type="terminal"]
    emit_release_narrative_document [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="release.emit_narrative_document" label="Emit release narrative document" output_key="release_narrative_document_delivery" output_format="json" outputs="release_narrative_document_json_path:json_path,release_narrative_document_markdown_path:markdown_path" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_category="delivery" action_contains_internal_only="false" action_context_b64="${release_report_context_b64}" action_input_contract="release.report_context@v1+release.narrative@v1+release.report_issue_delivery@v1" action_internal_only_sections="[]" action_issue_url="${release_report_issue_url}" action_narrative_b64="${release_narrative_b64}" action_output_contract="release.narrative_document_delivery@v1" action_output_dir="reports/release/narratives" action_publishable="true" action_repo_path="${repo_path}" action_tags="[\"release-report\",\"factory-ops\"]" action_taxonomy="[\"delivery\",\"operations\"]" action_topics="[\"${gh_repo}\",\"${factory_id}\"]" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    encode_release_narrative [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.encode_base64" label="Encode release narrative (base64)" output_key="release_narrative_b64" action_value="${release_narrative}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    encode_release_report_context [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.encode_base64" label="Encode release context (base64)" output_key="release_report_context_b64" action_value="${release_report_context}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    encode_release_slack_payload [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="common.encode_base64" label="Encode release Slack payload (base64)" output_key="release_slack_payload_b64" action_value="${release_slack_payload}" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    load_release_narrator_skill [type="tool" governance="reversible" label="Load release narrator skill" output_key="release_narrator_skill_content" prompt="cat packages/factory-skills/skills/runtime/release_narrator/SKILL.md" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    narrative_delivery_gate [shape="diamond" label="Narrative wants delivery?"]
    post_release_to_slack [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="release.post_to_slack" label="Post release report to Slack" output_key="release_slack_delivery" action_context_b64="${release_report_context_b64}" action_input_contract="release.report_context@v1+release.slack_payload@v1" action_output_contract="release.slack_delivery@v1" action_payload_b64="${release_slack_payload_b64}" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    publish_release_report [type="tool" governance="irreversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="release.publish_report" label="Publish release understanding issue" output_key="release_report_issue_delivery" output_format="json" outputs="release_report_issue_url:issue_url" action_repo="${release_reporting_repo}" action_context_b64="${release_report_context_b64}" action_input_contract="release.report_context@v1+release.narrative@v1" action_narrative_b64="${release_narrative_b64}" action_output_contract="release.report_issue_delivery@v1" recovery_owner="supervisor" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    release_narrator [class="release_narrator" benchmark_job_id="supervisor.tick.release_narrate" llm_path_id="capability.release_report_flow.release_narrator" prompt_version="2026-03-21.r1" role_version="2.0.0" skill_id="supervisor.release_narrator" label="Narrate release capability shift" output_key="release_narrative" output_format="json" outputs="delivery_decision,headline,summary,report_body" reasoning_effort="low" timeout="5m" prompt="You are the release narrator for ${gh_repo}.\n\n${release_narrator_skill_content}\n\nRelease context JSON:\n${release_report_context}\n\nReturn a JSON object with the keys described in the skill contract above. No markdown fences." session_id="supervisor-${factory_id}"]
    start [shape="Mdiamond"]
    update_release_dedup_cursor [type="tool" governance="reversible" action_runtime="in_process" action_id="release.update_dedup_cursor" label="Update release dedup cursor" output_key="__release_dedup_cursor_result" action_factory_id="${factory_id}" action_context_b64="${release_report_context_b64}" action_delivery_status="${release_report_issue_delivery}" action_input_contract="release.report_context@v1+release.delivery_status@v1" action_output_contract="release.dedup_cursor_update@v1" trust_domain="${trust_domain}" trust_role="${trust_role}"]
    start -> build_release_report_context -> load_release_narrator_skill -> release_narrator -> narrative_delivery_gate
    update_release_dedup_cursor -> done
    build_release_slack_blocks -> encode_release_slack_payload
    create_shaping_followup_issue -> build_release_slack_blocks [condition="delivery_decision=slack_and_issue"]
    create_shaping_followup_issue -> update_release_dedup_cursor [condition="delivery_decision=issue_only"]
    emit_release_narrative_document -> create_shaping_followup_issue
    encode_release_narrative -> publish_release_report
    encode_release_report_context -> encode_release_narrative
    encode_release_slack_payload -> post_release_to_slack
    narrative_delivery_gate -> done [condition="delivery_decision=skip"]
    narrative_delivery_gate -> encode_release_report_context [condition="delivery_decision!=skip"]
    post_release_to_slack -> update_release_dedup_cursor
    publish_release_report -> emit_release_narrative_document
}
